During the [[Kymoodon Era]] an '''assault''' was made on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lexrul/Legends|Lexrul]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] by raiders backed by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The raiders successfully captured slaves although some colonists on the planet escaped. Those that did escape then witnessed a [[Clan battle on Lexrul|clan battle]] fought using [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetically]] enhanced slave berserkers. The assault was included in a report made to try and warn people of the dangers of colonizing the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|rimward]] terriotes. The report was stored in a [[Kymoodon-era government archive|government archive]] on the planet [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]], which was rediscovered in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The rediscovery lead to [[Thunys Albegron]], an academician of Popular Studies, to mention the assault during the [[Conference on Popular Entertainment]] held on the planet [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assault was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry.
